adults_hand_bags.description: Cabin (hand) bags per adult, one entry per adult (each 0-1), e.g. [1, 1]
adults_hand_bags.title: Adults Hand Bags

adults_hold_bags.description: Checked (hold) bags per adult, one entry per adult (each 0-2), e.g. [1, 0]
adults_hold_bags.title: Adults Hold Bags

allow_diff_airport_connection.description: Allow connections that change airports within the same city
allow_diff_airport_connection.title: Allow Diff Airport Connection

allow_self_transfer.description: Allow self-transfer (virtual interlining) connections between separate tickets
allow_self_transfer.title: Allow Self Transfer

children_hand_bags.description: Cabin (hand) bags per child, one entry per child (each 0-1), e.g. [1]
children_hand_bags.title: Children Hand Bags

children_hold_bags.description: Checked (hold) bags per child, one entry per child (each 0-2), e.g. [2]
children_hold_bags.title: Children Hold Bags

departureDate.description: Departure date in dd/mm/yyyy — the day to fly, or the earliest date of a range (see departureDateTo)
departureDate.title: Departuredate

departureDateFlexDays.description: Search +/- this many days around departureDate (symmetric). Leave 0 when using departureDateTo
departureDateFlexDays.title: Departuredateflexdays

departureDateTo.description: Latest departure date in dd/mm/yyyy for an explicit range [departureDate .. departureDateTo]. Use instead of departureDateFlexDays for a one-directional or asymmetric range; must be >= departureDate
departureDateTo.title: Departuredateto

exclude_airlines.description: Exclude flights operated by these airlines — comma-separated IATA codes, e.g. 'FR,W6'. Mutually exclusive with select_airlines
exclude_airlines.title: Exclude Airlines

exclude_stopover_airports.description: Never connect via these airports — comma-separated IATA codes
exclude_stopover_airports.title: Exclude Stopover Airports

exclude_stopover_countries.description: Never connect via these countries — comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes
exclude_stopover_countries.title: Exclude Stopover Countries

flyFrom.description: Origin: IATA code, city or airport name (e.g. "PRG", "Prague", "London Heathrow")
flyFrom.title: Flyfrom

flyTo.description: Destination: IATA code, city or airport name
flyTo.title: Flyto

fly_days.description: Allowed outbound departure weekdays — comma-separated 0=Sun..6=Sat, e.g. '1,2,3,4,5' for weekdays
fly_days.title: Fly Days

max_fly_duration.description: Maximum total flight duration in hours
max_fly_duration.title: Max Fly Duration

max_sector_stopovers.description: Maximum number of stopovers (connections) allowed per flight sector
max_sector_stopovers.title: Max Sector Stopovers

nights_in_dst_from.description: Minimum nights at destination before return flight. Turns the search into a return search
nights_in_dst_from.title: Nights In Dst From

nights_in_dst_to.description: Maximum nights at destination before return flight
nights_in_dst_to.title: Nights In Dst To

one_for_city.description: If true, return only the single best result per destination city — useful for 'explore' searches with broad destinations
one_for_city.title: One For City

price_from.description: Minimum total price filter in the specified currency
price_from.title: Price From

price_to.description: Maximum total price filter in the specified currency
price_to.title: Price To

returnDate.description: Return date in dd/mm/yyyy — the day to fly back, or the earliest return date of a range (omit for one-way)
returnDate.title: Returndate

returnDateFlexDays.description: Search +/- this many days around returnDate (symmetric). Leave 0 when using returnDateTo
returnDateFlexDays.title: Returndateflexdays

returnDateTo.description: Latest return date in dd/mm/yyyy for an explicit range [returnDate .. returnDateTo]. Requires returnDate; use instead of returnDateFlexDays; must be >= returnDate
returnDateTo.title: Returndateto

select_airlines.description: Only include flights operated by these airlines — comma-separated IATA codes, e.g. 'FR,U2,BA'. Mutually exclusive with exclude_airlines
select_airlines.title: Select Airlines

stopover_airports.description: Only connect via these airports — comma-separated IATA codes. Constrains connecting flights only; direct (non-stop) flights are still returned.
stopover_airports.title: Stopover Airports

stopover_countries.description: Only connect via these countries — comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, e.g. 'DE,AT'. Constrains connecting flights only; direct (non-stop) flights are still returned.
stopover_countries.title: Stopover Countries
